title: Hierarchical Pooling for Sheaf Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.20932v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sheaf neural networks (SNNs) extend graph neural networks by operating on cellular sheaves, which assign to each node and edge its own vector space, along with linear restriction maps from node spaces to the spaces associated with their incident edges. These maps determine the sheaf Laplacian and can be learned at each layer, enabling layer-specific diffusion dynamics. Existing SNN architectures, however, always diffuse on the same graph, with restriction maps that may change across layers but continue to act on the original nodes and edges. We introduce Hierarchical Sheaf Pooling (HiSP), a pooling layer that enables hierarchical representation learning in SNNs. Following the Select-Reduce-Connect-Lift framework, HiSP groups fine-scale nodes, reduces their features using the fine-scale sheaf structure, and constructs the corresponding coarse graph. A new sheaf is then learned at the coarse resolution. By interleaving sheaf diffusion

translated_title: 层神经网络的层次化池化
translated_abstract: 层神经网络通过在胞腔层上运作来扩展图神经网络；胞腔层为每个节点和边分配各自的向量空间，并定义了从节点空间到与其相关联的边空间的线性限制映射。这些映射决定了层拉普拉斯算子，并且可以在每一层中学习，从而实现各层特定的扩散动力学。然而，现有的 SNN 架构始终在同一个图上进行扩散：其限制映射虽然在层与层之间可以变化，但始终作用于原始的节点和边。我们提出了层次化层池化，这是一种能够在 SNN 中实现层次化表示学习的池化层。HiSP 遵循“选择—缩减—连接—提升”框架，对细尺度的节点进行分组，利用细尺度的层结构缩减其特征，并构建相应的粗化图；随后在粗分辨率下学习一个新的层。通过交替进行层扩散……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 提出 HiSP 层次化池化层，通过节点分组、基于细尺度层结构缩减特征并构建粗化图，再在粗分辨率下学习新的层结构，使层神经网络能够实现层次化表示学习。
en_tdlr: We introduce Hierarchical Sheaf Pooling (HiSP), a Select-Reduce-Connect-Lift pooling layer that enables hierarchical representation learning in sheaf neural networks by grouping fine-scale nodes, reducing features via the fine-scale sheaf structure, and learning a new sheaf on the coarsened graph.
